sloka: कामं लोकास्त्रयः सेन्द्राः ससुरासुरमानवाः ।भवतामग्रतः स्थातुं न पर्याप्ता रणाजिरे ।। ५.४६.१३।।।।
transliteration: kāmaṁ lokāstrayaḥ sendrāḥ sasurāsuramānavāḥ ।bhavatāmagrataḥ sthātuṁ na paryāptā raṇājire ।। 5.46.13।।।।

translations.english: "Even Indra, suras, asuras and humans and the three worlds together are incompetent to stand before you in a battlefield.
